name: DIACEREIN 50 MG 30 VIAFLEX CAPSULES
description: Diacerein 50 mg 30 capsules Viaflex is an anti-arthritic medication indicated for the treatment of symptoms of knee and hip osteoarthritis in adults. It acts as an anti-inflammatory, inhibiting the production of interleukin-1, a substance that plays an important role in cartilage degradation. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
